families.title: Color-channel partition integrity
families.hypothesis: Declared channel groups cover each finite synthetic profile component exactly once without empty or overlapping groups.

families.title: Profile-link transition projection
families.hypothesis: A finite synthetic profile-link graph projects deterministically while retaining every labelled conversion edge.

families.title: Unsupported color-conversion trace
families.hypothesis: A requested synthetic conversion sequence is refused exactly when no declared transform trace realizes it.

families.title: Color-conversion step candidates
families.hypothesis: Each adjacent synthetic profile-space transition exposes its declared candidate transform steps without claiming device behavior.

families.title: Synthetic gamut-boundary split
families.hypothesis: A declared scalar proxy partitions a finite synthetic color set into disjoint in-bound and out-bound groups.

families.title: ICC-profile tag allowlist
families.hypothesis: Only requested synthetic profile-tag actions that are explicitly granted remain in the permitted projection.

families.title: Calibration-record expiry state
families.hypothesis: Normalized synthetic timestamps expose premature, active, or expired calibration metadata without asserting calibration.

families.title: Color-profile revision lineage
families.hypothesis: An ordered synthetic correction and revocation history yields an as-of profile-scope projection without erasing earlier states.

families.title: Color-record correction-route coverage
families.hypothesis: Every synthetic profile or color-only-cue issue is mapped to a declared review route or retained unresolved.

families.title: Color-review timing window
families.hypothesis: A synthetic review submission is labelled timely, late, or missing while remedy and publication authority remain reserved.

families.title: Color-metadata disclosure minimization
families.hypothesis: A synthetic color record releases only requested fields that are present and explicitly allowed.

families.title: Color-difference explanation coverage
families.hypothesis: Missing source-space, transform-basis, or manual-review explanations remain explicit rather than inferred.

families.title: Accessible palette action alternatives
families.hypothesis: Declared reviewer roles determine finite synthetic palette actions and explicit withheld reasons.

families.title: Finite profile-release role deficit
families.hypothesis: The finite profile-release role set reports each absent reviewer category and forces release_allowed false.

families.title: Non-color accessibility-mode vacancy
families.hypothesis: Missing text, shape, screen-reader, or plain-language modes remain explicit and affected-user evaluation stays reserved.

families.title: Color measurement-model separation
families.hypothesis: Synthetic observations, transform models, assumptions, and unknowns remain typed apart and cannot become empirical evidence.

families.title: Tristimulus dimension-composition guard
families.hypothesis: Synthetic arithmetic proceeds only for matching declared color dimensions and creates no real measurement.

families.title: Color-conversion workload budget
families.hypothesis: A finite synthetic conversion queue retains held work when its declared workload budget is exhausted.

families.title: Color-profile rollback checkpoint
families.hypothesis: The latest declared reversible synthetic profile checkpoint is exposed while every real rollback remains open.

families.title: Color-profile publication authority gap
families.hypothesis: Missing publication scope or competent authority remains exact-gated and cannot be supplied by software.
